page_title: RAY 0-0 MAL | Rayo Vallecano v Mallorca 24/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

90+3' What a wasted opportunity by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Dominik Greif makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
90+2' Rough tackle by Cyle Larin (Mallorca). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano in a dangerous position.
90+1' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90+1' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Isi Palazon.
89' Substitution. Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Jorge de Frutos.
89' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano).
84' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Ricardo De Burgos signals. Mallorca have a free kick.
84' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
82' The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.

81' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Dominik Greif anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
79' The substitution is prepared. Johan Mojica (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Toni Lato.
78' Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.

78' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Dominik Greif, who pulls off a stunning save! Rayo Vallecano win a corner.

77' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano win a corner kick.

76' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Augusto Batalla pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
76' Poor challenge! Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for tripping and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle. Mallorca are awarded a free kick.
75' Ricardo De Burgos shows the yellow card to Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) for a heavy challenge.
72' Here is a change. Antonio Sanchez is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
72' Substitution. Marc Domenech is replaced by Jan Salas (Mallorca).
72' The attendance for today's match is 13854.
71' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
70' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

69' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo De Burgos with no other option than to blow for a foul. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick.
67' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Dominik Greif is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
66' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
65' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) replacing Omar Mascarell.
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) for Vedat Muriqi.

63' CHANCE! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
60' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Mallorca get a free kick.
59' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Ivan Balliu and he is replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
58' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
56' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul after Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
56' Marc Domenech (Mallorca) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Rayo Vallecano.
55' Ricardo De Burgos has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano). A free kick is awarded to Mallorca.
53' Samu Costa (Mallorca) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
53' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is ready and denies him.

53' He should have scored! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the left post is pretty weak and Dominik Greif makes an easy save.
52' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
50' A substitution has been made. Unai Lopez is replaced by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).
48' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
47' The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
46' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Mallorca.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
45+2' The foul by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ricardo De Burgos.
45+2' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Mallorca will take a free kick.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.

45' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo De Burgos no option but to blow his whistle. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
43' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
43' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Dominik Greif.
41' An attempted cross from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is cleared.
40' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

39' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
38' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Ricardo De Burgos didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
38' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca are awarded the free kick.
36' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
36' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
34' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.

30' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
30' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Toni Lato (Mallorca) heads on.
27' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
27' Mallorca concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
25' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
23' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
23' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) comes to nothing.

23' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rayo Vallecano.

21' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) loses his marker in the box from the resulting corner, times his jump well but flashes his close-range header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
21' The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
20' Samu Costa (Mallorca) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
19' Samu Costa (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
18' Samu Costa (Mallorca) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
17' Samu Costa (Mallorca) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
15' One of the players from Mallorca times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
15' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul. Mallorca have been awarded a free kick.
14' Good movement by Marc Domenech (Mallorca), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
11' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
8' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
6' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

6' It looks like Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) saw red with that tackle. Ricardo De Burgos won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
2' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Mallorca will take a free kick near the side line.
1' A pass from Marc Domenech (Mallorca) is intercepted by Augusto Batalla and the move breaks down.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos will referee today's match.
